invariants.Source raw note: NodeControl mixes UI, services, and reusable node responsibilities; future CLI/non-UI use must not depend on Blazor.
invariants.Expected behavior: A UI-independent NodeControl abstractions project contains contracts and models used by NodeControl without depending on Blazor, ASP.NET components, desktop UI, or the web app project.
invariants.Disallowed shallow implementation: Moving files without adding a project boundary, or creating marker interfaces that still depend on UI assemblies.
invariants.Production assertions: bundle://proof/SB03/transcripts/project-reference-graph.txt and bundle://proof/SB03/transcripts/abstractions-forbidden-dependency-scan.txt prove dependency direction and forbidden UI dependency absence.
invariants.Red-team negative case: bundle://proof/SB03/transcripts/abstractions-forbidden-dependency-scan.txt rejects Blazor/Web/Desktop/component source dependencies in the abstractions project.
invariants.Downstream dependency check: bundle://proof/SB05/manifest.md and bundle://proof/SB06/manifest.md consume the extracted contracts.
